title: TJ-D1 Code-Substrate Three-Arm Verdict Batch: Artifact Package (P02 companion)
description: Artifact package for the paper 'Architecture Search in Self-Modifying Systems: The Scale-Decay Regularity of General Selection and Randomized Controlled Audit Discipline' (Paper B) and its code-substrate verdict experiment TJ-D1. Contains: experiment scripts (skill-graph platform, scale scan, three-factor scan, GEP pipeline, three-arm batch runner), per-run immutable event logs, verdict JSONs with criteria SHA256, preregistration and authorization records, self-authored task deck (48 tasks with reference solutions, brute-force cross-checks, trap solutions, and deterministic test generators), and the frozen validation deck (8 validation + 13 test instances) with its SHA256. All local experiments reproduce on a single RTX 3080 Laptop 16GB; the API tier uses DeepSeek V4.1 Flash.
notes: MANIFEST.sha256 lists SHA256 for every file; verify after download. Deck freeze: deck_frozen.json SHA256 2386a3437df9cb7fac93122574785367987b073a033cf8c3e8a708117a3b8016. Criteria freeze: TJ-D1-frozen-v1.0.json (SHA256 recorded at freeze time).
